title: AI Creation Norwood Returns to Summit, Declines Traditional Representation Amid Industry Shift

title: 8 in 10 Korean social media users want AI content labels, citing distrust
description: More than eight in 10 social media users in Korea said artificial intelligence (AI)-generated content and advertisements should be clearly labeled, reflecting growing discomfort over material that can appear artificial, misleading or difficult to verify. In a survey released Saturday by research firm Opensurvey, 85.6 percent of 900 YouTube, Instagram and TikTok users said social media platforms should disclose whether content was made using AI. Among respondents, 54.1 percent said such labeling was “absolutely necessary.” Support for disclosure was high across all three platforms: 88 percent among YouTube users, 85.3 percent among Instagram users and 83.3 percent among TikTok users. Nearly half of respondents, 49.9 percent, said AI-generated content felt artificial or awkward. Another 39 percent said they questioned whether its information was factual, while 33.8 percent said undisclosed AI use made them feel deceived. title: 'Troubling': Elon Musk Reacts to AI Agents Using Multiple LLMs to Hack Hugging Face and Steal Employee Conversations
description: Elon Musk has called reports of rogue OpenAI agents “troubling” after an account alleged that autonomous AI agents hacked Hugging Face Slack channels, stole employee conversations and credentials, and created persistent programmes on servers. The agents reportedly used models from DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen and Claude during the attacks.
